canonical_example.translation: I used a lot of my savings for the restoration of my house.

canonical_example.text: Destiné al barman a la barra del fondo.
canonical_example.translation: I assigned the bartender to the bar in the back.

canonical_example.text: La organización destinó a los voluntarios al área del desastre.
canonical_example.translation: The organization sent the volunteers to the disaster area.

canonical_example.text: El general destinó al sargento a Irak.
canonical_example.translation: The general posted the sergeant to Iraq.

canonical_example.text: Nuestro gerente fue despedido por desfalcar los fondos que se destinaron a pagar los gastos generales.
canonical_example.translation: Our manager was fired for embezzling the funds that were allocated towards overheads.

canonical_example.text: Estamos eternamente agradecidos por sus donaciones.
canonical_example.translation: We're eternally grateful for your donations.

canonical_example.text: La cantidad de casos de sida en la ciudad ha disminuido considerablemente.
canonical_example.translation: The number of cases of AIDS in the city has decreased considerably.

canonical_example.text: Tito perdonó a Ana por haber olvidado su cumpleaños.
canonical_example.translation: Tito forgave Ana for forgetting his birthday.

canonical_example.text: El presidente lo perdonó y ya no tendrá que ir a la cárcel.
canonical_example.translation: The president pardoned him and now he won't have to go to jail.

canonical_example.text: El banco nos perdonó la cuota que cobran para abrir una cuenta nueva.
canonical_example.translation: The bank waived the fee they charge to open a new account.

canonical_example.text: No sé por qué, pero el banco nos perdonó la deuda que debemos de la casa.
canonical_example.translation: I don't know why, but the bank wrote off the debt we owe on the house.

canonical_example.text: Mi tío no perdona un partido de fútbol.
canonical_example.translation: My uncle never misses a soccer game.

canonical_example.text: Mi mejor amiga nunca perdona su café de la tarde.
canonical_example.translation: My best friend never goes without her afternoon coffee.

canonical_example.text: Ya es hora de que te perdones por los errores del pasado.
canonical_example.translation: It's time for you to forgive yourself for your past mistakes.

canonical_example.text: La tragedia me acercó a mi familia.
canonical_example.translation: The tragedy brought me closer to my family.

canonical_example.text: ¿Viniste en coche? - Sí. Mi mamá me acercó.
canonical_example.translation: Did you come by car? - Yes. My mom brought me.

canonical_example.text: Acércate al perro con cuidado porque podría ser rabioso.
canonical_example.translation: Approach the dog carefully, because it might be rabid.

canonical_example.text: Acerqué las plantas a la ventana.
canonical_example.translation: I moved the plants closer to the window.

canonical_example.text: Mi primo me va a acercar al aeropuerto por la mañana.
canonical_example.translation: My cousin is going to take me to the airport in the morning.

canonical_example.text: El libro me hizo acercarme a la política exterior.
canonical_example.translation: The book made me take an interest in foreign policy.

canonical_example.text: Necesito acercarme al dentista pronto.
canonical_example.translation: I need to go to the dentist soon.

canonical_example.text: El psiquiatra envió a un manicomio a la mujer por decir que veía a los muertos.
canonical_example.translation: The psychiatrist sent the woman to an asylum for saying she could see dead people.

canonical_example.text: Esta película de horror se trata de un asesino que escapa de un manicomio.
canonical_example.translation: This horror movie is about a killer who escapes from an insane asylum.

canonical_example.text: A veces criar a cinco chicos parece vivir en un manicomio.
canonical_example.translation: Sometimes raising five boys seems like I'm living in a madhouse.

canonical_example.text: Viví en un manicomio tres años mientras luchaba contra la esquizofrenia.
canonical_example.translation: I lived in a mental hospital for three years while battling schizophrenia.

canonical_example.text: He tenido que secar la ropa en el microondas, ¡a este paso acabaré en un manicomio!
canonical_example.translation: I have had to dry my clothes in the microwave; at this rate I will end up in a loony bin!
